privacy.informationWeCollectDesc: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make a purchase, or contact us for support. This may include:
privacy.nameEmailPhone: Name, email address, and phone number
privacy.paymentInfo: Payment information (processed securely through our payment partners)
privacy.communications: Communications with our customer service team
privacy.howWeUseDesc: We use the information we collect to:
privacy.communicate: Communicate with you about your orders and account
privacy.marketing: Send you marketing communications (with your consent)
privacy.improve: Improve our services and develop new features
privacy.protect: Protect against fraud and ensure security
privacy.informationSharingDesc: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties, except in the following circumstances:
privacy.protectRights: To protect our rights and safety
privacy.dataSecurityDesc: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
